posts.raw_content:
Hey family, Ryan here


 Hope you’re all doing well. These midterms have been stirring something deeper in me. I keep coming back to the same thought: we may be missing something important. We’ve become far too dependent on the political system to be our savior. It’s easy to hide behind anonymous accounts, talk a strong game, and then wait for someone else to actually take the risk and walk it out.

 The disciples saw Jesus moving so powerfully that they were willing to die for it. Yet so often we sit back and wait for someone else to come save the day.

 What if Trump isn’t the one who saves us? What if, like John the Baptist, he was simply a messenger clearing the way for something much larger? A movement that rises above politics and comes together as a real, public body in the world—not just online.

 I know I’m not the sharpest person here, and many of you have poured yourselves into the digital work of holding this community together. But very little of what we talk about seems to turn into real-world action. It often stays at digital decodes that lead us to keep waiting… and waiting… and waiting.

 I don’t always know the best way to say what I feel needs to be said. But I do know this: for any lasting change to happen, this has to become about Jesus. Not politics. Not America. Not even primarily about taking down the deep state. Those things matter and play a part, but we have to remember that a united body of believers standing in truth and humble prayer is where real change actually begins.
I’ve been using my home state of Delaware as a kind of launch point for the vision the Lord has given me. After talking with people from all walks of life, I can say without hesitation that Jesus is preparing hearts and minds to unite around prayer and seeking Him. As I’ve been building in Delaware, the Lord has also shown me that .win—and each of you—have a role to play in this.

 Please pray over what I’m saying. Let’s start talking about real-world action. I’m willing to stand up where needed and put myself out there, but each of you carries a part that I simply can’t do for you. I can be a messenger, but I can’t force anyone to move. I believe the Lord has given me a vision that ties all of this together, and I’ve been patiently waiting for each of you to be activated.

 Love you all. I appreciate everything you do, and I’m grateful to walk this journey with you.

 ***Together through Christ  we have endless potential.***
